title: Optional link expiration
summary: Callers can give a short link an optional lifetime; expired links stop redirecting (410 Gone) and metadata exposes the expiry time.

functionalRequirements.description: POST /api/v1/urls accepts an optional expiresInMinutes; the link expires that many minutes after creation.
functionalRequirements.acceptance: expiresInMinutes between 1 and 525600 (one year) is accepted; 0, negative or larger values return 400 problem details; omitting it creates a link that never expires.

functionalRequirements.description: An expired link no longer redirects.
functionalRequirements.acceptance: GET /{code} on an expired link returns 410 Gone (problem details) and records no click; before expiry it still returns 302. Expiry is enforced even when the link is cached.

functionalRequirements.description: Link metadata shows when the link expires.
functionalRequirements.acceptance: GET /api/v1/urls/{code} and the 201 create response include expiresAt (null when the link never expires).

nfr.notes: Expiry check is on the redirect hot path and must not add a database round-trip on cache hits.

assumptions: Existing links (created before this change) never expire.
Expired links are kept (not deleted) so their statistics remain available.
Expiry is evaluated against the server clock (UTC); no grace period.
outOfScope: Changing or removing the expiry of an existing link
